note: This file is a pure MMDetection configuration file. It contains no functions, classes, or callable APIs — only variable assignments (dicts and lists) that configure a Mask R-CNN model with Caffe-style ResNet-50 backbone, multi-scale polygon training, and COCO dataset settings. No CLI-invocable code exists in this file.
